description: Lists the papers that cite a given paper, newest first. Every result carries a one line abstract, so you can judge a paper before you open it. This is the other half of the citation graph that paper_references covers, so a literature review can walk the graph in both directions. A showing line under the heading says which citing papers are on this page and how many there are in all, with the page to ask for next. Inputs: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807), page (optional, which page of results to show, 1 to 400, 1 by default), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8). Example prompt: 'who cited DOI 10.48550/arXiv.1706.03762?'

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 25.

page.description: Which page of results to show, 1 to 400, 1 by default. Pass the page the showing line names to read the next page.

paper.description: A DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807.
